player_prompt.intro:
Yaa Player {player_id} kɛ Nim.
Kɩɩrɩ yaa laŋɔ yɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ.
Kɩɩlɛ kɛɛrɛ, tɛŋɛ kɛɛrɛ pile yɔɔgɔ laŋɔ yɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ.
Tɛŋɛ format '[pile quantity]', pile wɛɛlɛ pile index yɛɛ laŋɔ quantity wɛɛlɛ kɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ.
Kɩɩlɛ kɛɛrɛ, '[0 3]' kɛɛrɛ 3 kɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ pile 0.

invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Jɛnɛ {player_id}, kɛɛrɛ kɔm. Kɔlɔm {col} tɛ wɛɛrɛ.
invalid_move.non_positive: B segd n yiisa bũmb a ye sẽn pa ta woto.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Tɛ kɛɛrɛ {quantity} sɔrɔ kɔm {pile_index} nɛ (kɛmɛ {pile_count} tɛ bɛ).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} kɩɩlɛ [{pile_index} {quantity}], kɛɛrɛ {quantity} kɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ pile {pile_index}.
